stage: Eighteen Etruscan release candidates pass exact original-native scope, pose, final production thumbnail and poster review; Baubo quality hold and C7011 integrity hold remain excluded. Combined sixty-work release validation/publication belongs to root.

sanitized_metadata_audit.geometry_count_scope: API detail only; actual selected payload geometry remains unmeasured in preparation metadata

process.binding: Before image review bind each actual original and preview to complete SHA256/bytes, exact UID and selected acquisition report. Record final renderer, transform, appearance and image hashes.
process.orientation: First compare acquired current thumbnails to the publisher front and known physical footing. Write an explicit upright transform. If axis is ambiguous, use B–G of existing orientation sheets; A is current/auto, not necessarily B. H–J turn the current transform, not the chosen B–G transform. For ±Z/±X-up choices keep yaw0 unless a render verifies the composed Euler turn; selecting the front with a reviewed camera viewDirection is safer than assuming the Euler Y rotation is world-vertical.
process.multi_view: For every explicit upright asset inspect preferred-front three-quarter, reverse, high view into openings, and underside. That is80 derivative views for20works. Compare the same source views where source/derivative material or geometry fidelity needs confirmation; initial source thumbnails alone cannot certify the reverse.
process.renderer: Use current production appearance functions and normalize from fresh source scene/clones per variant; never accumulate transformations. Preserve textures, authored COLOR_0, material base factors and PBR maps. Any lighting adjustment must be per-work and source-supported. Record any mesh hidden by name-based scan-helper removal and confirm it is not original artwork geometry, especially support disks or feet.

camera_plan_after_upright.note: These are review camera directions after a verified upright model transform, not final publication pose recommendations. Higher frontal cameras may suit bowls/kylix/brazier.

process.quality_gate: Separate original archaeological losses from scan incompleteness and environmental residue. Hold materially absent required surfaces, broken scan-only thin elements, misleading mirrored backs or room-dominated scope. State minor hidden/contact-surface limits without pretending they are complete original geometry.
process.size_gate: Apply no calibration or final starting size before matching exact object measurements, captured boundaries, final upright pose and preview binding.
